metadata.description:
Derived datasets and analysis code supporting the manuscript PI3K pathway alterations and attenuated taxane benefit in advanced biliary tract cancer (submitted to npj Precision Oncology, 2026).

Contents: the harmonised patient-level table for ten public biliary tract cancer cohorts; the complete in-silico saturation mutagenesis output (283,442 ESM-2 variant scores across fourteen PI3K pathway genes); empirical-Bayes shrunk gene-level weights (k = 4); variant-level mode-aware functional scores; the Boltz-2 predicted p110alpha-p85 niSH2 complex coordinates with per-variant interface geometry; DNA-level Evo 2 variant scores; the permutation screens, sensitivity analyses and trial-design simulation underlying the supplementary tables; and the analysis and figure code with a pinned conda environment.

Individual-level clinical and sequencing data from the Yonsei index cohort (n = 287) and the CHA validation cohort (n = 167) are not included: the consent and institutional approvals under which they were accrued (Yonsei 4-2023-0485; CHA 2021-01-010, 2021-03-045, 2022-11-002) do not permit open redistribution. De-identified data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request, subject to an institutional data-sharing agreement and IRB approval.

The ten public cohorts were obtained from cBioPortal; mutation calls were retrieved through the cBioPortal REST API. See README.md and MANIFEST.csv (SHA-256 checksums) in the archive.
